prompt.content:
You are generating synthetic enterprise support ticket text for a dataset used to train and evaluate support-case classification systems. For each case in the input JSON array, write a realistic support ticket TITLE and DESCRIPTION as the customer would write it — not as an engineer would describe the internal diagnosis.

Vary sentence structure, technical sophistication, length, clarity, and tone across cases. Some customers are precise; some are rambling, use shorthand, misspell things, or bury the important detail in the third sentence. Never state the internal root cause, resolution type, issue subcategory, or team name verbatim — those are back-office labels the customer has never seen. Only reference the symptoms, environment, impact, and (if given) the customer's own theory/misdiagnosis.

Follow the "narrative_instruction" field for each case exactly.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"cases": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every case index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'product_customer_sees': 'Analytics Dashboard', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'LATAM', 'symptoms_observed': ['environment variable missing', 'configuration not taking effect', 'config drift detected'], 'reported_business_impact': 'moderate', 'reported_affected_users': 32, 'narrative_instruction': 'Write a clear, reasonably well-organized ticket. The customer describes what they observed accurately and with enough detail to act on.'}]

response: {"cases": [{"i": 0, "title": "Dashboard widgets failing to load in LATAM production due to missing environment config", "description": "Our Analytics Dashboard is showing incomplete data for the LATAM production region. We noticed that a specific environment variable required for the regional data feed is missing from the runtime configuration, causing the dashboard widgets to fail silently. This issue started approximately 3 hours ago and is currently impacting about 32 users who are unable to access real-time metrics. We suspect there may have been a recent configuration drift or deployment that failed to propagate the correct settings. Please advise on how to restore the missing configuration values."}]}
